the hint is `Blowfish` [Cyberchef](https://cyberchef.formality.de/#recipe=From_Hex('Auto')&input=NDIgNmMgNmYgNzcgNjYgNjkgNzMgNjg)

it appears to work as a blowfish decryption key [Cyberchef](https://cyberchef.formality.de/#recipe=Blowfish_Decrypt(%7B'option':'UTF8','string':'Blowfish'%7D,%7B'option':'Hex','string':'000000000000000'%7D,'CBC','Hex','Raw')&&oeol=NEL)
which prints out some binary string with a weird header

if we strip the header, and convert from binary, it looks like a hex string, so we chain it to from hex in [Cyberchef](https://cyberchef.formality.de/#recipe=From_Binary('Space',8)From_Hex('Auto')&&oeol=NEL) to finally create a binary file
